summary.en: The title is a window: huge letters cut out of the stage show a live product picture drifting behind them; the word draws breath, then rushes out through one of its strokes until the picture fills the frame.
summary.zh: 超粗大字从舞台上挖成窗，字里透出缓慢漂移的产品画面；字先吸一口气，再从自己的一笔里冲出放大，产品画面接管全屏。

fits: The first shot of an opening or a chapter card where a name or one-word claim and the product belong together: the word is the door, the product is behind it; it ends on the product full frame, so the next scene can start inside it.
notFor: A light picture behind a light stage (the window must hold large areas of colour and bright lines); thin or light type; words longer than about nine letters (three Chinese characters); a film that also uses counter-portal through a stroke (the same idea twice).

overlaps.note: its stroke variant pushes the camera into a stem of letters that show the next scene; word-window holds the word still while the picture drifts inside it, and the word itself grows through the frame

intent.en: Make the name and the product one picture: the word is a door cut out of the stage, the product is seen through it, and as the word opens the viewer walks from the name into the product.
intent.zh: 让名字和产品成为同一个画面：字是在舞台上挖出的门，产品透过笔画显形，字胀开时观众从品牌词直接走进产品。

content.en: One heavy word (en ≤ 9 letters, zh ≤ 3 chars), an optional eyebrow (en ≤ 22 chars, zh ≤ 8) and subtitle (en ≤ 44, zh ≤ 16), and one live product picture with large areas of colour and bright lines (dark or darkened).
content.zh: 一个超粗的词（英文 ≤ 9 个字母，中文 ≤ 3 字），可选眉标（英文 ≤ 22 字符，中文 ≤ 8 字）和副标（英文 ≤ 44，中文 ≤ 16），加一张有大块色面和亮线的产品画面（暗色或调暗）。

fits.zh: 开场第一镜或章节卡，名字或一个词的主张与产品要放在一起：字是门，产品在门里；结尾产品占满全屏，下一场可以直接在它里面开始。

notFor.zh: 浅色舞台后面放浅色画面（窗里必须有大块色面和亮线）；细体或轻字重；超过约九个字母（中文三个字）的词；同一支片还用了 counter-portal 的穿笔画（同一招用两次）。

pairs.note: a quiet name first, then the word that opens into the product

en: Darken a light page or use its dark theme; the strokes must show large areas of colour and bright lines, or the word does not read as a window.
Do not outline the letters; variable fonts build glyphs from overlapping contours and an outline draws their insides.
The picture is watched in close-up the whole time; rasterise it at high resolution or it blurs inside the strokes.
Not in the same film as counter-portal's push through a stroke; both grow a world out of a word.
zh: 浅色页面要先调暗或换暗色主题；笔画里要透出大块色面和亮线，否则字读不出“窗”。
别给字形描边；可变字体的字形由重叠轮廓拼成，描边会画出内里轮廓线。
字里的画面全程被特写盯着；要高分辨率栅格化，否则在笔画里糊成一片。
别和 counter-portal 的穿笔画同片并用；两者都是“字里长出世界”。
